method.surfaces: VRV friction: dry asphalt 0.9, wet 0.6, ice 0.15; the vehicle brakes and turns at most friction x 9.81 m/s2, never above 8 m/s2
method.sensing: range 150 or 60 m (as in fog), position noise 0.15 or 0.5 m, heading noise 0.03 rad
method.harm: pedestrian/cyclist collision 100 x (1 + impact speed m/s); vehicle/obstacle collision 20 x (1 + v); half if the CAV stood still; close call (TTC < 1 s or gap < 1 m) 5; hard braking (> 6 m/s2) 1 each; 10 per second beyond grip in a curve; stopped short 0.2 per second lost; late arrival 0.05 per second over 1.5 x free flow
